newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Church & Dwight estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Church & Dwight estimate raised.

text.p: -- Prudential analyst Heather Hay said she raised the fiscal year 1997 and 1998 estimates for Church & Dwight Co Inc based on the strong fourth-quarter sales reported Thursday morning.
-- raised 1997 estimate to $1.20 per share from $0.95 per share and raised 1998 estimate to $1.30 per share from $1.02 per share.
-- Church & Dwight shares were up 1-5/8 to 24 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

-- "We are encouraged by ongoing growth in revenue base and improving cost structure. We remain concerned about the ability that CHD will have to sustain this in light of what promises to be a competitive year in the oral care arena."
-- maintained a hold rating on the company's shares.
